description: [STAGE 1: ARCHITECT] Alias of basecoat_setup_config. Generate production Tailwind CSS v4 setup, OKLCH tokens, and theme scripts.

componentId.description: Framework or style pack identifier alias.

environment.description: Target environment alias (html, astro, react, vue, svelte).

framework.description: Target framework or environment for setup instructions and boilerplate (astro, vanilla, nextjs, sveltekit, vite, htmx). Defaults to astro.

id.description: Framework or style pack identifier alias.

includeDarkThemeScript.description: Whether to include the synchronous inline <head> dark mode bootstrap script to prevent theme flashing. Defaults to true.

name.description: Framework or style pack identifier alias.

stylePack.description: Aesthetic style pack preset (vega: standard shadcn New York v4, nova: modern SaaS, maia: playful organic, lyra: brutalist technical, mira: compact editorial, luma: soft modern, sera: architectural flat, rhea: curved modern). Defaults to vega.
